description_en: Sets the archive status of a specified agent session to archived or unarchived. This API operation is available only when the canary release feature is enabled. Before calling this operation, ensure that the canary release feature is enabled for the current account and the destination region
description_zh: 设置指定 Agent 会话的归档状态，支持归档和取消归档。本接口需要开启灰度才可以使用。调用前请确认当前账号及目标地域已开启相应灰度
name: ArchiveAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC protocol version. Set this parameter to 2.0 when you call the operation
parameters.help_zh: JSON-RPC 协议版本，调用时填写 2.0
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The correlation identifier of the JSON-RPC request generated by the caller. The identifier is returned as-is in the response. This field is not an idempotency token
parameters.help_zh: 调用方生成的本次 JSON-RPC 请求关联标识，响应原样返回；该字段不是幂等令牌
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to archive the session. Valid values:
true: Archive the session.
false: Unarchive the session.
Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否归档。true：归档；false：取消归档。省略时默认为 true
fields.name: archived

fields.help_en: The ID of the target session. Use the SessionId returned by CreateAgentSession or obtained from ListAgentSessions
fields.help_zh: 目标会话 ID，使用 CreateAgentSession 返回的 SessionId，或从 ListAgentSessions 查询获得
fields.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The session operation parameters. The parameters are serialized as a JSON object and submitted as a form field. The parameters must include SessionId
parameters.help_zh: 会话操作参数。以 JSON 对象序列化后作为表单字段提交，必须包含 SessionId
parameters.name: params

schema.description_en: The session operation response, which includes the OpenAPI request ID and the JSON-RPC business result
schema.description_zh: 会话操作响应，包含 OpenAPI 请求 ID 和 JSON-RPC 业务结果

JsonRpcResponse.description_en: The JSON-RPC response. Result is returned if the call is successful, and Error is returned if a protocol error occurs
JsonRpcResponse.description_zh: JSON-RPC 响应。成功时返回 Result，协议错误时返回 Error

Error.description_en: The JSON-RPC fault message. This field is not returned if the call is successful
Error.description_zh: JSON-RPC 错误信息；成功时不返回该字段

Data.description_en: The optional additional error information. The content depends on the error type
Data.description_zh: 可选的错误附加信息；内容取决于错误类型

Data.title_zh: 可选的错误附加信息；内容取决于错误类型。

Id.title_en: 本次请求的 JSON-RPC 关联标识，由调用方传入并原样返回。
Id.title_zh: 本次请求的 JSON-RPC 关联标识，由调用方传入并原样返回。

Archived.description_en: The archive status after the operation is completed. A value of true indicates that the session is archived, and a value of false indicates that the session is unarchived
Archived.description_zh: 操作完成后的归档状态。true 表示已归档，false 表示未归档

SessionId.description_en: The ID of the session for which the archive status is set
SessionId.description_zh: 已设置归档状态的会话 ID

Timestamp.description_zh: 响应时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

Timestamp.title_zh: 响应时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。
